writing_strategy.voice: Concise, professional B2B playbook labels; first-person plural only in the confirmed title.
writing_strategy.casing: Title Case for steps, group labels, categories, activities and downstream items; brand names verbatim.
principles: Labels name things; they do not explain them. Explanatory copy limited to the slots Step 04 defined.
Canonical names, corrected names and corrected orders used exactly (constraints 008, 009).
Tool optionality stated once globally; tool chips carry names only (constraint-001).
No numbers beyond step numbers, tier names and confirmed counts; no scores (constraint-006).
Every item stays within its max_words_hint because overall density is very high.
writing_strategy.optional_policy: Optional count labels generated (confirmed Step 02 facts that aid scanning). Optional gloss, role hint and placement note omitted for consistency and density; reasons recorded.

visual_units.objective: Our 6-Step ABM Playbook: end-to-end path from TAM and stakeholder mapping to closed-won, with optional tools per step.

content_items.preferred_text: Tools shown are optional alternatives, not a required stack. Some tools appear in more than one step.

omitted_optional_content.reason: Placement inside the one-to-many lane already communicates decision-017; a note would add density without new meaning.
No other signal category carries a gloss; adding one only for Gated Content would be inconsistent in a very dense Step 3. The category label is kept.
No other tool chip carries a role hint; Tavily keeps its required name label. Role remains traceable via fact-005.

preserved_constraints.statement: Present every tool/platform as an optional alternative; never as a required stack or recommendation to use all.
preserved_constraints.how_preserved: Global optionality note (node-optionality-note); chips carry names only, nothing says "required".

preserved_constraints.statement: Repeat a tool in each step it belongs to (e.g. Ocean.io in Steps 1 and 2); do not deduplicate across steps.
preserved_constraints.how_preserved: Repeated tools get their own label item in every step (e.g. Ocean.io, AI Ark, Findymail in Steps 1 and 2; HubSpot in six places).

preserved_constraints.statement: Do not invent tool or vendor names; signal categories and parallel dialing / gifting remain without vendors.
preserved_constraints.how_preserved: Only confirmed names used; signal categories, Gifting Campaigns and Parallel Dialing have no vendor text.

preserved_constraints.statement: Number exactly six steps; downstream items and closed-won are unnumbered.
preserved_constraints.how_preserved: Step numbers 1–6 only; downstream items and Closed-Won have no number.

preserved_constraints.statement: Show only the path toward closed-won; no closed-lost branch.
preserved_constraints.how_preserved: Closed-Won is the only outcome text; no Closed-Lost wording anywhere.

preserved_constraints.statement: No numerical scores or thresholds; no mapping between awareness stages and tiers.
preserved_constraints.how_preserved: No scores or thresholds; relationship note states there is no fixed stage-to-tier mapping.

preserved_constraints.statement: Demand generation is one-to-one / one-to-many, not inbound/outbound; video outreach sits in one-to-many.
preserved_constraints.how_preserved: Lane labels One-to-One / One-to-Many; Video Outreach labelled in one-to-many; no inbound/outbound wording.

preserved_constraints.statement: Use corrected orders: considering before selecting; sequence enrollment before CRM tasks; recap order for steps.
preserved_constraints.how_preserved: Considering before Selecting; Enroll in Sequences before CRM Tasks; step order 1–6.

preserved_constraints.statement: Use Claygent (not Clay) in Step 2, Claude Code (not Claude), and X (formerly Twitter).
preserved_constraints.how_preserved: Claygent (Step 2), Claude Code, X (formerly Twitter) used verbatim.

preserved_constraints.statement: Do not show excluded items as active content: Apollo, Pipedrive, Reddit ads, email opens as a category; website visits only under first-party.
preserved_constraints.how_preserved: No text for Apollo, Pipedrive, Reddit or Email Opens; Website Visits appears only under first-party.

preserved_constraints.statement: HubSpot and Salesforce are either/or CRM options, not both required.
preserved_constraints.how_preserved: Either/or marker between HubSpot and Salesforce in Step 5.

preserved_ambiguities.copy_handling: Gifting Campaigns and Parallel Dialing labelled with no tool or "TBD" text.
Signal category labels only; no vendor names.
Event Invites, Automated Outbound, Public Events and Video Outreach labelled with no tool text and no "pending" wording.
Stage and tier labels only; no scoring criteria text.
Slack Notification labelled without any trigger wording.
HubSpot chip in Step 4 carries its name only; no function described.

semantic_checks.name: Upstream Step 02/03/04 artifacts unchanged during writing
Brand tool labels are exact canonical names (X uses the corrected form; generic Custom Scrapers title-cased)
Step, category, stage, tier, activity and downstream labels equal source names (case-insensitive)
Step 4 uses confirmed name "Score + Tier Accounts"; title is "Our 6-Step ABM Playbook"
No excluded names, inbound/outbound framing, closed-lost, step 7, scores, mandatory or pending wording
Count labels match both Step 04 node counts and Step 02 facts
Corrected orders preserved in copy (stages; downstream)
Repeated tools labelled in every instance (no dedup)
Optionality stated globally; no chip implies a tool is mandatory
Information flow wording says "inform", not a dependency/trigger
Required requirements all generated; omitted items optional with reasons; none blocked
One item per requirement-target combination, targets unchanged from Step 04
Step numbers only on the six steps; with-number variants keep the name unchanged
Read every preferred text and variant for tone, clarity and source fidelity
Subtitle "From identifying accounts to closing deals" matches requirement-001 scope without implying a closed-lost path
Omission of the gloss, role hint and placement note loses no required meaning
Fit of copy inside rendered cards / legibility
